full_prompt_en: A square painterly still life arranges fruit, glass vessels, and a few pale flowers on a white cloth before a dark interior wall. The table runs across the lower portion of the frame, its front edge slanting gently down toward the right. On the left, a shallow warm-gray bowl holds several small round yellow fruits, some partly hidden behind the rim. Behind it stand a slim deep-green bottle and a taller brown glass bottle, both dimly reflective. Near the center, a short transparent tumbler contains a muted rose-colored liquid; broad horizontal brush marks describe the glass and its contents. At the front right, half of a large round fruit rests on the cloth with its mottled pink-red interior facing the viewer and a dark green rind around its edge. A white ceramic pitcher stands just behind it, its handle curving outward on the right. Farther back, a blue jug holds a loose cluster of cream-white flowers and dark stems, set against a deep green and charcoal recess. Roughly vertical wall panels and warm brown framing occupy the left background; the other side falls into nearly black shadow. The picture is built with quick, layered watercolor or thin oil-like strokes that leave paper or ground showing through in places. Soft light comes from the left front, brightening the cloth, pale fruit, ceramic pitcher, and flower heads, while the darker bottles and wall recede. Shadows beneath the objects are broad blue-gray patches rather than hard silhouettes. There is no readable text. The overall composition groups bright rounded forms against angular dark planes, balancing earthy browns and greens with strong blue, white, and muted red accents.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式静物将水果、玻璃器皿和几朵浅色花摆在深色室内墙面前的白布上。桌面横贯画面下部，前缘轻轻向右下倾斜。左侧一只浅暖灰色碗盛着数枚圆圆的黄色小果，部分藏在碗沿后。碗后立着一只细长深绿瓶和一只更高的棕色玻璃瓶，两者都只有暗淡反光。中央附近，一只矮透明杯盛着低饱和玫瑰色液体；宽阔的水平笔痕表现玻璃和杯中之物。右前方，半个大圆果放在布上，斑驳的粉红果肉朝向观者，边上环着深绿色果皮。其后有一只白色陶瓷水壶，壶柄在右边向外弯曲。更靠后，蓝色壶中插着松散的奶油白花朵与深色花茎，置于深绿和炭黑色凹处之前。大致竖向的墙板与暖棕色边框占据左侧背景，另一边沉入近黑阴影。画面由迅速叠加的水彩或稀薄油彩般笔触建立，某些地方露出纸底或底层。柔光从左前方照来，照亮白布、浅色水果、陶瓷壶和花头，深色瓶子与墙面则向后退。物件下方的阴影是宽阔蓝灰色块，而非硬边剪影。画中没有可读文字。整体构图让明亮的圆润形态聚在有棱角的暗平面前，以土棕和绿色平衡强烈的蓝、白与低饱和红色重音。
style_prompt_en: The painting uses loose, layered brush marks and thin, partly translucent color to build a rich but unstable surface. Warm brown, olive, and charcoal fields surround compact passages of vivid blue, creamy white, muted rose, and yellow. Rounded light shapes overlap angular dark planes, creating depth through value and occlusion more than precise perspective. Edges shift from carefully suggested contours to areas where pigment dissolves into the neighboring tone. The pale lower plane carries broad cool shadows and exposed ground, while darker upper regions compress the space. Soft directional light catches selected surfaces without smoothing the tactile marks. The overall effect is intimate and exploratory, balancing the weight of dark interior color with lively, incomplete-looking passages of light.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画用松散叠加的笔痕和稀薄、部分透明的色彩建立丰富却不稳定的表面。暖棕、橄榄绿与炭黑色场包围紧凑的鲜蓝、奶油白、低饱和玫瑰色和黄色区域。圆润亮形与带棱角的暗平面重叠，纵深更多由明度与遮挡而非准确透视形成。边缘从精心提示的轮廓变为颜料溶入相邻色调的区域。下方浅色平面承载宽阔冷影与露出的底层，上方较暗区域则压缩了空间。柔和定向光触及选定表面，却没有抹平可触的笔痕。整体效果亲密而富探索感，让深沉的内部色彩与活跃、仿佛未完成的亮色笔段相平衡。

theme_zh: 桌上有柑橘、器皿、花朵与切开瓜果的静物画
name: Frances Hodgkins
